title: work:close closes a released record: archive, reconcile log entry, header
goal: Closing a record on its release tag is one command instead of hand edits
acceptance: npm run work:close -- <ID> --release vX.Y.Z checks the tag is on GitHub, sets its steps closed with zero remaining, archives the record under its closing week and updates the week counts
It prints the reconcile draft for the PRs since the header's main and leaves the header text to the agent
Fixture tests; check:backlog and check:work pass on the result
privacy: Procedure, tool and config text only; examples invented; no personal data.
escalation: A closure without a published tag or green CI is refused, never forced

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
